item.theaurorian2.sealed_artifact_advanc: The sealed pointer never looks back; its strength belongs only to the path ahead.
- Enhances the next two slots ahead in the same column.
Silent sigils line its edge, urging the bearer to strike before the next heartbeat.
item.theaurorian2.sealed_artifact_choice: - Enhances the slots directly ahead and directly right.
Choice promises no return; every wager cast illuminates both paths at once.
item.theaurorian2.sealed_artifact_desire: - Enhances two slots along each upper diagonal.
Desire spreads along both wings of sight, sowing longing where no hand has reached.
item.theaurorian2.trophy_moon_queen.tool: Justice left unfinished, ideals shattered, and her sword...
item.theaurorian2.world_scroll.tooltip.u: Hold to unfold and follow the remembered path.
item.theaurorian2.world_scroll.tooltip.f: Another sky turns slowly beneath the page.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.receiv: When you wake, an unfamiliar scroll is resting in your hands.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.dismou: The scroll cannot find a path while you are riding.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.combat: The trembling page will not open while danger is close.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.wrong_: No distant sky answers from this place.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.missin: The world beyond the page could not be reached.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.first_: The page closes. The sky above is no longer the one you knew.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.entere: The scroll follows the route it remembers.
message.theaurorian2.world_scroll.return: The scroll returns you to the mark left in your world.
message.theaurorian2.purification.comple: The Aurorian mark is cleansed. The Moon now shelters you.
message.theaurorian2.purification.alread: You have already completed the Purification Ritual.
message.theaurorian2.purification.in_pro: The Purification Ritual is already in progress.
message.theaurorian2.purification.busy: The altar is answering another pilgrim.
message.theaurorian2.purification.interr: The Purification Ritual was interrupted. The Aurorian mark remains.
message.theaurorian2.purification.player: The pilgrim has fallen. The Purification Ritual failed.
message.theaurorian2.purification.altar_: The altar's shields are gone. The Purification Ritual failed.
gui.theaurorian2.purification.title: Purification Ritual
gui.theaurorian2.purification.warning: You will permanently lose every Aurorian blessing.
gui.theaurorian2.purification.reward: In return, you will gain the purely defensive Moon Shield.
gui.theaurorian2.purification.poem.title: Purification Altar Prayer
gui.theaurorian2.purification.poem.line1: Do not go gentle into that good night,
gui.theaurorian2.purification.poem.line2: Life must be kindled in rebellion,
gui.theaurorian2.purification.poem.line6: Burn, burn the ghosts that wheel across the night sky.
gui.theaurorian2.purification.poem.line1: And the bitter, frigid wind, in solitude,
Curse me, bless me. I long for it,
Never to go gentle into that good night.
Burn, burn the ghosts that wheel across the night sky.

item.theaurorian2.crimson_pact_pendant.t: The crimson pact promises no immunity, only that every kill will repay its price.
- After 1 second of damage, consumes Crimson Shield each second to restore %s health.
- Converts the Moon Shield into a Crimson Shield.
- Killing creatures grants one tenth of their maximum health as Crimson Shield.
item.theaurorian2.gloomy_pauldrons.toolt: - Moon Shield: shield-break penalty cooldown reduced by %s; shield recovery speed increased by %s.
- Crimson Shield: effective attacks have a %s chance to restore 1 Crimson Shield.
The dark does not deny moonlight; it teaches the fragments to return in silence.
